slots.name: overcrowding rate
slots.sentence: Renacer comes as Colombia continues to struggle with overcrowding across its prison system -- a rate of 27.1% in March, according to the National Penitentiary and Prison Institute, or INPEC.

slots.name: official prison capacity
slots.sentence: Government figures have previously put the national prison system's official capacity at about 82,000 people but the country was holding more than 100,000 prisoners.
